subject: GreenBridge: hosted API residency controls and deletion evidence
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@greenbridge.com>

Cc: GreenBridge Security <security@greenbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick Q: where data lives & how we can force erasure (hosted API)

Jordan —

Thanks for the demo last week. Security team had a couple of clarifying asks about your hosted API:

1) For data submitted to text generation endpoints, can you confirm the physical region(s) where raw request/response logs are stored? We need a clear mapping to US regions for our auditors.
2) If we request customer-initiated erasure for a tenant, what is the actionable end-to-end timeline (including snapshots/backups)? Can you call out the API/ops steps and the maximum time to full purge from all backups?
3) Is there a manual purge or one-off deletion process you support for compliance escalations?

We appreciate a short, itemized reply we can hand to our compliance team.

—Alex
Alex Morgan
Security Engineering
GreenBridge Health
alex.morgan@greenbridge.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Q: where data lives & how we can force erasure (hosted API)

Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise breakdown you can share with auditors; I attached a short flow diagram and a regional TTL matrix. TL;DR: hosted API customer data is stored in the region selected at account creation; full purges are completed within our stated SLA windows but snapshots/backups have an additional bounded retention period (details below).

1) Physical regions:
- Primary storage and logs: US-West (Oregon) or US-East (N. Virginia) depending on the tenant region selection.
- Metadata and control plane: multi-region within US, encrypted at rest.

2) Erasure workflow & timelines:
- Customer API: "DELETE /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/data" — marks tenant data for removal from primary stores and invalidates KV caches. Actioned within 0-2 hours.
- Asynchronous background sweep: scans and removes KV cache shards and prefix caches within 24 hours.
- Backup/snapshot window: periodic snapshots are retained for up to 14 days for disaster recovery by default; deletions are applied at snapshot rotation, so worst-case full removal from backups is <= 14 days.
- Operational escalation: we can initiate accelerated purge of snapshots; see item 3.

3) Manual purge and compliance escalations:
- We offer an expedited purge request (Evidence & Authorization required) that fast-tracks deletion from snapshot stores. Typical completion for expedited requests: 48–96 hours from authorization.
- We provide attestation once the expedited purge completes.

Attachments: hostedapi-deletion-flow.pdf (flowchart), geo-ttl-matrix.csv (region/TTL table).

If you want, Ben (data infra) can provide the low-level log retention table and Stephanie can include SOC2 artifact IDs.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GreenBridge: hosted API residency controls and deletion evidence

Looping in Ben to add the log/snapshot specifics Ben — please confirm these points for the reply to Alex: 

- Audit logs (event-level): retained in primary region for 30 days; then moved to cold store for 90 days (read-only) before final deletion.
- Backups: incrementals every 6 hours, full weekly snapshot. Default snapshot retention 14 days; we can shorten that for enterprise contracts.
- Expedited purge steps: 1) receive written request + PO/authorization; 2) raise internal purge job; 3) validate and run; 4) provide attestation and timestamped report.

Ben, can you add the internal ticketing and SLA references (JIRA/OPS runbooks) so we can include a link in the final email?

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GreenBridge: hosted API residency controls and deletion evidence

Alex —

Following up with the technical annex you asked for. Below are the precise artifacts and operational references we will share once we receive a formal evidence request from GreenBridge security:

- Region mapping: tenant region -> primary storage (US-West: us-west-2, US-East: us-east-1). We will include IP ranges and datacenter provider details in the evidence pack.
- Snapshot removal: expedited purge process invokes the backup-eviction job which deletes affected snapshot shards; we record the job id and a SHA256 of the manifest and provide that in the attestation. Expected time 48–96 hours.
- Logs: event logs are logically separated from request/response payloads. Payloads (text) are stored in encrypted blobs with separate key rotation; we remove blob references and cipher text on purge.
- JIRA/OPS refs: PURGE-OPS (internal runbook), OPS-2028-PURGE (playbook), SOC2-EVID-2028-07 (artifact id for deletion attestations).

Next steps for GreenBridge: 
1) Please submit an official Evidence Request to security@redwood.ai with the tenant_id and authorized signer.
2) We'll intake the request and provide an estimated completion ETA within 4 business hours.

If you want the shorter summary for your auditors, I can send a one-page attestation with timestamps once we have the tenant_id.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Director, Infrastructure Reliability
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
